{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Will|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Will''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores [[Reach]] I. It is crafted from four [[Stable Void]]s.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/reach.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Will" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Will is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Reach applies to chestplates and adds 2 blocks of block interaction range. Level I is the only level any source gives, although the enchantment goes up to III.
